Name: Urijah, Priest
Summary: Urijah the priest built a new altar in Jerusalem after the pattern Ahaz sent from Damascus, and offered on it instead of the bronze altar, following the king's command.
RelatedPeople: Ahaz, King of Judah; Tiglath-Pileser, King of Assyria
LifeLesson: A priest who builds what a king sketches has traded his calling for favour.
